purpose: Keep ALIMI and /view role-separated while sharing one mode-scoped read-only evidence lineage.
global_invariants: Never combine Shadow Paper Live Backtest or Disabled metrics in one value.
Every visible metric must expose mode source_key source_sha generated_at age and integrity_state.
Stale or unbound data can never render as HEALTH_OK or green.
Zero unavailable unbound standby and not_applicable are distinct states.
Candidate strategy side and Team chips render active color only when the same-mode candidate is active and lineage-complete.
ALIMI and /view may mirror the same mode-scoped evidence but may not read different writers for the same metric.
ZBot recommends only; Lico validates execution realism; Zico reports OMS lifecycle; Zlice reports lineage; none may obtain order authority through UI.
No frontend fallback may import a prior epoch prior mode or legacy ledger metric.
Existing cards are preserved; changes are additive regrouping relabeling or collapsible presentation only.
No UI element may imply Paper or Live readiness when the corresponding release gate is closed.

tradingview_read_only_observer.fallback: Explicit CHART_UNAVAILABLE card with endpoint status and source age; never a silent blank panel.
